name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🎙️ Buddy understands more: small hive beetles, "queen not seen", "queenright", repeats and "try that again".
🐝 Mites said with no number? Buddy asks the count right away. Wash types: alcohol, dish soap, or just "wash".
🟫 Brood frames counted? Buddy asks how much brood. Only "solid", "tight" or "even" set a solid pattern.
🗣️ Talking about the hive while Buddy waits starts the inspection. "Don't stop" no longer stops it.
🔔 A new reminder shows at the top of Home: open the hive, mark it done, or skip it.
🩺 Disease signs are saved as "Possible…" so a sign is never taken as a diagnosis.
